summary: The doctor command and collector are implemented and the required validation passes, but the saved plan is not fully satisfied because the doctor-layer tests do not cover all planned plain-language failure mappings.
gaps: Add doctor-layer tests that assert the Docker diagnostic maps DOCKER_CLI_NOT_FOUND and DOCKER_SOCKET_UNREACHABLE to readable message/action output; current doctor tests cover DOCKER_DAEMON_UNREACHABLE and worker Docker failures but not these Docker availability cases.

Add doctor-layer tests that assert the GitHub diagnostic maps GITHUB_TOKEN_ENV_MISSING and GITHUB_CLI_NOT_FOUND to readable message/action output; current doctor tests cover GITHUB_AUTH_UNUSABLE, while the missing-token and missing-gh cases are only covered below the doctor layer.
